test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: ‘Courage and Conviction : An Autobiography’ is the autobiography of which of the following persons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VK Singh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **General Vijay Kumar Singh**, **PVSM, AVSM, YSM, ADC **is an **Indian politician **and a **former four-star General **in the **Indian Army**.
 
• He is the current Minister of State in the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways **and the **Ministry of Civil Aviation **in the **Second Modi ministry.**
 
• He was **born on 10 May 1951 in Pune**.
 
• **Courage and Conviction: An Autobiography **is an **autobiographical book **by **Indian General Vijay Kumar Singh **written with **Shiv Kunal Verma**.
 
• He is a **member of the Lok Sabha **since **2014 **from the **Bhartiya Janta Party**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lieutenant General Yogesh Kumar Joshi**, **PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, VrC, SM, ADC **is a **retired General Officer **of the **Indian Army**. He was the **General Officer Commanding-in-Chief Northern Command**.
 
• **General Dalbir Singh Suhag**, **PVSM, UYSM, AVSM, VSM, ADC **is the **current Indian High Commissioner **to Seychelles and **a former Chief of Army Staff **of the **Indian Army**. He was the **25th Chief of the Army Staff **of the **Indian Army**.
 
• **General Manoj Mukund Naravane PVSM AVSM SM VSM ADC is **a **retired Indian Army General **who served as the **27th Chief of the Army Staff**, as well as the **temporary Chairman **of the **Chiefs of Staff Committee from 15 December 2021 **until his **superannuation on 30 April 2022**.
